## History

Grandma Irving is mentioned as the grandmother of young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), whose father is [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). After her son [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) wanting to reconnect with his past love, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps arrange their reunion. Ultimately, [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to reunite with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P13](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0013), +132 more_

## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

Grandma Irving is the grandmother of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Her grandson is known in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for his unique imagination, which he shares with close friends like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Though she is his relative, his stories and imaginative discussions are largely shared with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

- Relative of — grandmother  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), +4 more</sub>
